pull.title: KAFKA-15853: Move quota configs into server-common package
pull.body:
- Pull all quota configs from `KafkaConfig`, `DynamicConfig` and `LogConfig` into `ServerQuotaConfigs` in `server-commons` as replication configs are shared between server, storage and tools packages. 

- Moved all quota configs definitions/docs/default values out of `ClientQuotaManagerConfig` and `ReplicationQuotaManagerConfig` as all quotas has the same default values for sample and window size. 

### Committer Checklist (excluded from commit message)
- [ ] Verify design and implementation 
- [ ] Verify test coverage and CI build status
- [ ] Verify documentation (including upgrade notes)
